---

## 1. 先問管理員

```text
Hi! I'm Guan Feng Lai, the developer of a phonics app for ages 3 to 7 (Lumi Letters Pro). Before posting anything, I wanted to ask: does the group allow developers to share their own resources, and if so, is there a promo day or thread I should use?

I'd say who I am in the first line, keep links out of the post, and lead with a free printable tracing-sheet tool that works without the app. If it's not a fit for the group, no problem at all. Thanks for running the group.
```

---

## 2. 社團貼文（管理員同意後）

```text
Developer here, so please read this with that in mind. I'm Guan Feng Lai, and I made a phonics app for 3 to 7 year olds. Sharing two things: a free printable tool, and the app itself.

The free part first. If you just need tracing sheets, I built a small browser tool where you type the letters your child is working on (up to 12 per sheet), pick uppercase, lowercase or both, and choose dotted, outline or faded letters. It prints clean and needs no account or app. Link in the comments if the group allows it.

The app is Lumi Letters Pro. What it does:

- Order: letter names and letter sounds first, then beginning, ending and middle sounds, then reading from pictures.
- Handwriting: all 26 letters, uppercase and lowercase, traced with crosshair guide lines.
- Practice: 14 planets with 12 question types (listen and choose, first and last sounds, upper/lowercase matching, missing letters, what comes before or next), plus a daily challenge and a time race.
- Records: a Parent Zone that splits progress into letter recognition, alphabet order, phonemic awareness and picture phonics.
- Off-screen: a "Today's Worksheet" PDF with tracing boxes for the letters practised that day.

It's a one-time purchase: no subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads. No data collected, progress stays on the device, and it works offline. The interface can be switched inside the app to 50 languages if another language is easier for a grandparent or co-teacher; the content stays English letters and sounds.

If you'd rather try before paying, there's a free version, Lumi Letters Lite, which you can unlock later with one purchase.

Happy to answer questions here.
```

---

## 3. 留言回覆範本

**Q: How much is it?**
```text
It's a one-time purchase, priced in your local App Store, with no subscription or in-app purchases after that. If you want to try first, the free Lite version unlocks the same content with one purchase.
```

**Q: What's the difference between Lite and Pro?**
```text
Lite is free to download and you unlock the full app once, behind a parent gate. Pro is paid up front and has no purchase screens at all inside. Going by the two store listings, the unlocked content is the same: 26 letters, 14 planets, 12 question types, the four-skill Parent Zone and the PDF worksheet. Pro mainly suits shared devices where you don't want any purchase screen.
```

**Q: Is it Android?**
```text
It's on the Apple App Store. The free tracing-sheet tool works in any browser, though.
```

**Q: Does it teach a specific handwriting style?**
```text
In the app, kids trace real stroke shapes with crosshair guide lines. If you follow a specific handwriting program, keep using its style on paper. The free browser tool uses a standard sans-serif letter shape, not a program font, and says so on the page.
```

**Q: Does it collect my child's data?**
```text
No. There's no account, no data collection, and progress stays on the device. It also works without internet.
```

**Critical comment:**
```text
Thanks for saying so directly. What didn't work for your child? I'd genuinely like to know so I can fix it.
```
（不刪留言、不爭辯、不私下要求對方改評分。）
